kevin: quick sync 11 gov sector customer asks for tamper-evident BYOK import records anchored to an external ledger. can we design a minimal flow?
tara: yes. two pieces: 1) provenance blob (signed by operators + hsm attestation) stored immutably; 2) a compact audit index (leaf hash + root_ref) in our DB. external anchor = periodic notarization of merkle root.
devon: sketch: import -> create blob with operator_ids, hsm_fw_hash, import_method, workstation_nonce, timestamp -> compute leaf=sha256(blob) -> append leaf -> compute new merkle_root -> HSM signs root -> write root+sig to ledger-bucket (immutable). DB row stores leaf_hash and root_ref.
kevin: RBAC? who can write blobs and who can notarize?
tara: import-write only for `hsm-import-operator` (dual-op required). `notarizer` role for signing roots (security infra). `audit-read` for legal + tenant auditors. no one else can delete.
compliance: retention=10 years for financial audits. need locality tag (region/hsm-id). notarized roots should include timezone-stamped anchor evidence.
devon: vuln note: attacker could swap `blob_ref` in DB. mitigation: store leaf hash in DB and sign that hash before inserting. nightly job should re-hash blobs to verify integrity.
kevin: incident flow if verification fails?
tara: immediate quarantine of affected key, create P1 incident, freeze routing, snapshot ledger and DB state, run root-trace to find divergence point, notify customer+legal.
sec-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-9001 assigned=devon severity=high channel=#release-war-room
devon: KMS nuance: use tenant CMK for encrypting blobs when customer has one; infra CMK for signing roots and DB-level metadata. document key-policy exceptions.
compliance: also need export-control fields if cross-border anchors used. provide consent checkbox in onboarding.
kevin: action items: tara -> RFC sketch for merkle+anchor flow (EOD); devon -> prototype verifier CLI + k8s cronjob for nightly verification (mid-next-week); compliance -> formal retention + export-control text (EOW).
tara: will include sample blob schema and minimal proof payload for /verify API.
kevin: great. keeping this thread as canonical for ledger-anchored provenance. post refs (PCI/FedRAMP) here if you have them. :thumbsup:
